description: Rate-of-rise thresholds for the USGS river-rise detector (src/aguayluz/hazard_adapters/river_rise.py, scripts/ingest_usgs_river_rise.py). Stage rises are in feet over the stated window; q_ratio is current discharge over the 6-hour minimum. See docs/RIVER_RISE_MONITORING.md.

calibration.method: scripts/calibrate_river_rise.py replays 15-minute runs over historical USGS instantaneous values, each run seeing only readings at least 45 minutes old.

promotion.note: Episodes and alerts are recorded only for these classes. Alerting stays off until the calibration backtest passes; the state file and dashboard panel show every class regardless.

50059050.note: Río Grande de Loíza below Carraizo dam: sudden rises can be spillway or gate releases, not rain.
